_meta.note: Transactional emails sent by functions through Resend (BE-48d, D50). Copy is a backend DRAFT for PO approval: change status to approved in PO_ANSWERS. Placeholders: {name} = the recipient's first name (the greeting falls back to greeting_no_name when blank), {end_date} = the trial end date in the recipient's timezone (e.g. 'Saturday, 8 November'). Never prices, percentages, answer or message text, partner names, images or tracking pixels.

trial_ending.trigger: day 5 of the 7-day trial (same window and quiet hours as the trial_ending push), once per trial (transactional, promised on the P3 timeline)
trial_ending.subject: Your free trial ends on {end_date}
trial_ending.preheader: Here's the reminder we promised. Nothing to do if you want to keep Premium.
paragraphs: Here's the reminder we promised: your free Bonded Premium trial ends on {end_date}.
Want to keep it? You don't need to do anything. Your subscription starts when the trial ends, and Premium stays on for both of you.
Rather not? Cancel anytime before {end_date} in your App Store or Google Play subscriptions. You'll find a shortcut in Bonded under Settings.
Thanks for making a little room for each other every day.
trial_ending.footer: You're getting this email because you started a free trial in Bonded. It's the only trial reminder we send.
